candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and ReadTimeout to order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; cause of redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading to order ReadTimeout and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout, matching the redis-timeout taxonomy. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Redis-side telemetry is unavailable, so the underlying trigger remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency, saturation, and error metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis client timeout configuration and retry behavior
